test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of interest (R) = 9% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Substitute the given values into the formula:

⇒ SI = (2000 × 9 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 18) / 100

⇒ SI = 360

**The simple interest is ₹360.**
